notes.title: New Update for Demo - v0.0.11
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello[/h1][/b]

The most requested improvement, a mouse control for a paddle, is right now available.
I've also made few modifications for default settings. In the previous version, the player could not call supporters on the first map and had only two blue spells available. 
Now, there will be at least one supporter ready on start (Ranger), and I have added one buff-spell on start as well (Luck).
This will give players a bit more variety of options to use on start. After a few unlocked maps, there should be a couple of spells more to use.

Steam Next Fest is really awesome. It is hard to express how thankful I am for all the comments and how happy I am to see new players in Tiny Breakers Camp. 
Have Fun!

Attack!

notes.title: New Update for Demo - v0.0.6
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello brave Heroes![/h1][/b]

The last few weeks, I have been working on a new battle location. This time, Heroes will move to Orcs Camp in order to challenge new villains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666071/7b0618024a79962680b0f0890804997e51e52013.png[/img]

There are few more improvements and changes.
[list]
[*]  New location - Orc Camp.
[*]  Demo Campaign has been extended by 3 more missions. There is possibility to unlock one more spell and two additional hidden supporters.
[*]  There are 3 additional enemy mobs that the player might face during the battle. 
[*]  I have added a new tab in Camp panel dedicated to Supporters and Enemy Mobs. You can check there the strength of your and enemy units. 
In order to unlock information about hidden units, it will be necessary to progress with the Campaign.
[*]  Change a bit the shape of the platform to give a bit more control over ball bouncing direction.
[*]  Add a couple of new animations for UI elements.
[*]  Turn Up volume for Music, SFX and UI and modified slightly Audio Option in Menu to allow for more room for volume modification.
[/list]

Attack!
